# No-Show & Cancellation Fee Calculator

> Free calculator for personal trainers, salons, tutors, and therapists: work out a defensible no-show fee, see whether overbooking the empty chairs still beats collecting it, and copy a cancellation policy.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
